source_text: Tingunt tunicam in sanguine haedi; pater luget. Haec Homiliae XV finis de venditione Ioseph. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: They-dip tunic in blood of-kid; father mourns. These of-Homily XV end about sale of-Joseph. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[They dip the tunic in the kid’s blood; the father mourns >> Bible:Genesis 37:31-35]]. This is Homily XV’s end on Joseph’s sale. Amen.
